key_catalyst: Pending Apple and Amazon earnings after tonight's close, combined with the Fed's hawkish 3-dissent hold and 10-year yield at 4.70%
reasoning: Apple and Amazon are reporting earnings after tonight's close, creating binary overnight risk on top of a fragile market that only today broke a four-day losing streak. The Fed's hawkish hold with three dissents and the 10-year yield spiking to 4.70% create a fundamentally unfavorable backdrop for growth valuations, and Meta's 7-9% drop on collapsing free cash flow demonstrates that AI capex concerns remain an active landmine ahead of two more mega-cap reports. Recent history shows earnings-driven selloffs (7/24 Tesla/Alphabet, 7/28-29 semiconductor crash) can cascade quickly, and today's rally was heavily dependent on a single stock (Microsoft) while breadth concerns persist.
